verdict.rationale: pnpm documents per-project Node.js pinning and installation (devEngines.runtime, 'install and pin Node.js per project… no nvm, no shell hooks'), and it auto-switches to the pnpm version declared in packageManager/devEngines.packageManager on first use. That covers the tool-version half of the story, but the switch happens through pnpm itself rather than when you enter a directory. The only environment-variable evidence is ${NAME} substitution inside config files, which is an adjacent feature and does not activate project env vars. missing for 10: automatic activation on directory entry, project-scoped environment variable loading, version management for tools beyond Node.js and pnpm, independent hands-on corroboration.
